description: This file defines the class OA_Maintenance_Priority_DeliveryLimitation_Common, which provides an interface and common methods for handling delivery limitations in an ad server, including checking if delivery is blocked based on date/time constraints.

classes.name: OA_Maintenance_Priority_DeliveryLimitation_Common
classes.description: A class that defines the interface and some common methods for delivery limitations related to ad delivery blocking based on time constraints.

methods.name: deliveryBlocked
methods.description: Determines if the delivery is blocked at a given date/time, returning true if blocked, false if not, or an error.
